edges.reason: msg.sender is used as payee and as the identity authorising a balance withdrawal from the payments mapping.
msg.sender determines which player record is modified and which address receives crystals during an attack.
The constructor stores msg.sender as administrator, granting full privileged control to the deployer.
The isAdministrator modifier compares msg.sender against administrator before allowing selfdestruct.
The disableContract modifier requires tx.origin == msg.sender, making tx.origin a gate condition on atkBoss.
block.timestamp gates the nextTimeAtk cooldown and is emitted as timeAtk in the attack event.
block.timestamp is the primary entropy source of randomNumber and is miner manipulable.
randomNumber supplies the attack multiplier, allowing timestamp based grinding of damage outcomes.
upgrade executes selfdestruct to the caller supplied addr under admin authorisation.
withdrawPayments performs a native transfer to the payee after state has been updated.
withdrawReward pushes native tokens to an arbitrary _addr supplied by the caller via transfer.
withdrawReward first settles pending share through updateShareETH before computing the payout.
atkBoss calls Engineer.subVirus against the external engineer contract.
atkBoss calls MiningWar.addCrystal against the external mining war contract.
atkBoss triggers external interface calls whose results and side effects are not verified on chain.
atkBoss invokes endAtkBoss which credits prize ETH after external calls, enabling cross-function state issues.
endAtkBoss finalises the round and immediately calls startNewBoss to begin the next round.
startNewBoss reads Engineer.prizePool and calls Engineer.claimPrizePool to pull the round reward.
startNewBoss performs external interface calls to claim the prize pool from the engineer contract.
startGame calls startNewBoss after marking the initial round as ended.
updateShareETH calls calculateShareETH to determine the pending share value.
atkBoss calls updateShareETH to settle the attacker's previous round share before applying new damage.
getCurrentReward calls calculateShareETH to include the in-progress round share in the total.
atkBoss writes totalDame and playerLastAtk into the current bossData record.
atkBoss writes nextTimeAtk, currentBossRoundNumber and dame into the player record.
withdrawPayments reads and then zeroes payments[payee].
withdrawPayments decrements totalPayments by the withdrawn payment.
asyncSend increases the payments credit for the destination address.
asyncSend increases totalPayments by the credited amount.
setMiningWarInterface assigns the validated interface to the MiningWar state variable.
setEngineerInterface assigns the validated interface to the Engineer state variable.
setMiningWarInterface calls isMiningWarContract on an attacker supplied address before trusting it.
setEngineerInterface calls isEngineerContract on an attacker supplied address before trusting it.
setContractsMiniGame whitelists the supplied address in the miniGames mapping.
setContractsMiniGame calls isContractMiniGame on an arbitrary address to validate it.
setBossRoundNumber lets the administrator arbitrarily overwrite the current round index.
removeContractMiniGame clears the miniGames flag for the supplied address.
startGame sets the init flag to true so it cannot be executed twice.
startGame marks the initial bossData round as ended.
setDefenceBoss lets the administrator set the boss defence used in damage computation.
setBossHPDefault lets the administrator set the boss HP that scales with the round number.
setHalfTimeAtkBoss lets the administrator control the attack cooldown that gates atkBoss.
startNewBoss increments bossRoundNumber and multiplies it with BOSS_HP_DEFAULT without SafeMath.
startNewBoss constructs a new BossData entry with the computed hp, def and prize pool.
endAtkBoss marks the current bossData round as ended and reads prizePool and totalDame.
endAtkBoss credits the last attacker's win with the ETH bonus and share.
calculateShareETH reads the player record to derive dame and round markers.
calculateShareETH reads boss prizePool, totalDame and ended flag for the share computation.
getCurrentReward reads win, share and round markers from the player record.
withdrawReward zeroes win and share on the player record after transferring.
updateShareETH reads and updates share and lastBossRoundNumber on the player record.
updateShareETH checks the ended flag of the player's previous boss round.
The constructor assigns administrator from msg.sender at deployment time.
The constructor calls setMiningWarInterface with a hardcoded address after administrator is set.
The constructor calls setEngineerInterface with a hardcoded address after administrator is set.
The user supplied _value feeds multiplications that determine attack damage and crystal rewards.
The user supplied _addr becomes the transfer recipient of the reward payout.
payee local carries the msg.sender derived recipient into the transfer call.
payment local supplies the amount forwarded by the transfer call.
rate multiplies the user supplied _value to derive the attack value.
atk is compared against boss defence to compute the final damage.
dame drives totalDame updates, crystal bonuses and player damage accounting.
crystalsBonus is passed to the external MiningWar.addCrystal call.
The mini game address parameter is validated and written into the whitelist.
The round number parameter is assigned directly to bossRoundNumber by the administrator.
The addr parameter is the destination of the admin controlled selfdestruct.

normalization_plan.reason: atkBoss._value is an input parameter consumed only by atkBoss for damage arithmetic and should be folded into that core function node.
withdrawReward._addr is a parameter used only inside withdrawReward as the transfer recipient and is merged into it.
withdrawPayments.payee is a local derived from msg.sender and only feeds the native transfer operation.
withdrawPayments.payment is a local balance value that only determines the amount of the native transfer.
atkBoss.rate is an intermediate local computed inside atkBoss and has no meaning outside it.
atkBoss.atk is an intermediate local computed inside atkBoss from _value and rate.
atkBoss.dame is an intermediate local holding the damage applied within atkBoss.
atkBoss.crystalsBonus is an intermediate local passed to the external crystal reward call made by atkBoss.
setContractsMiniGame._addr is a parameter used only inside setContractsMiniGame for validation and whitelisting.
setBossRoundNumber._value is a parameter assigned directly to state inside setBossRoundNumber.
upgrade.addr is a parameter consumed only by the selfdestruct operation invoked by upgrade.
